description: Build an aging report for accounts receivable or payable. Send the as-of date and the open invoices (each with its due date and the amount still open; credits as negative amounts). Get back the totals and counts in the standard buckets (current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90 and over 90 days past due), each bucket's share of the total, every invoice's days past due and bucket, the oldest item and the amount-weighted average days past due. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/aging-report). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

as_of.description: The date the report is as of, YYYY-MM-DD.

amount.description: Amount still open; a credit or unapplied payment as a negative amount.

label.description: Your own label (an invoice number or customer code, up to 6 digits in a row; not a person).

ledger.description: receivable (money owed to you) or payable (money you owe). Changes only the wording.
